questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The Italian culture in general and the opportunity to have some EU-related courses. The history of UNIBO also played a part.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: After arrival, it was easier than before arrival but still not easy with regards to enrolling courses and exams.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I received assistance from the UNIBO administration and from other exchange students.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Difficult. In the end, I did not have a lot of options. I would have preferred better options through UNIBO.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Not much. It depends on the landlord and possible roommates.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration process was primarily done through the Learning Agreement (LA). The LA was extremely difficult to get right because the information about available courses to enroll in was insufficient and the process on signing the LA was slow from my home University. The Check-in procedure worked fine.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Help from UNIBO administration through email only.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: In the end successful but the procedure up until that point was very confusing.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: That, even though you can't find that information beforehand, you can probably get the courses you want.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The academic level was overall good.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The style of teaching was must more characterized by a necessity to listen to what the teacher says and not so much the books which is opposite of what is characterizing teaching at the UCPH.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Go for day-trips to other cities and walks in the hills south of Bologna. The rail network is great. There are good museums and Bologna is a nice city to walk around but the size is limited.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go for day-trips to other cities and walks in the hills south of Bologna. The rail network is great. There are good museums and Bologna is a nice city to walk around but the size is limited.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It doesn't take long.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Optimally go for courses in Italian. Not a lot of local students in courses in English.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The communication is more formal but not challenging. Administrative aspects such as enrolling in courses and exams is less structured. The same goes for exam dates that can change during the semester because it is entirely up to the teachers.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The culture for going out to eat, drink and socialize outside of your home is great. Cafés are comparably much cheaper and the food and coffee is great.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Don't, stress about courses and the Learning Agreement - they can be changed even after the semester has started and you can still go to the classes you want.
2. Try to find housing as early as possible. That will give you more options at cheaper prices.
3. Don't read too much - it is more important to go to classes physically.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Look above

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Experiencing the Italian (or just the non-Danish) culture at a longer-than-usual period. Also experiencing lots of other different cultures from exchange students all around the world.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Waiting for certainty on courses and exam dates.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
